packages.summary: Eight nights from Baku to Gabala and on to Tbilisi, with the Old City, Nohur Lake, wine country and the Kazbegi mountains.
packages.overview: This eight-night autumn journey starts in Baku with Highland Park, the Alley of Martyrs, the National Assembly, the Flame Towers and Baku Boulevard, followed by the Old City, Nizami Street and the Heydar Aliyev Center. group_trips.title: Baku, Gobustan, Gabala and Sheki Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A small-group circuit from Baku's Old City and the Gobustan rock carvings to the mountains of Gabala and the old silk-road town of Sheki.
group_trips.overview:
Azerbaijan is a country of contrasts, and this fixed-departure trip shows both sides. You spend three nights in Baku, taking in the Old City, the Flame Towers, the Heydar Aliyev Center, the ancient rock carvings at Gobustan and the burning hillside of Yanardag.

From there you head into the Greater Caucasus foothills, with a night at Gabala for its mountain scenery and Nohur Lake, and a night in Sheki, where the Palace of the Sheki Khans and the old caravanserai show another side of the country.

A trip captain travels with the group throughout, and Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Baku's UNESCO-listed Old City and the Flame Towers
Photo stop at the Heydar Aliyev Center
Gobustan rock carvings and mud volcanoes
Ateshgah Fire Temple and Yanardag burning hillside
Mountain scenery and Nohur Lake at Gabala

Travel with a trip captain and a small group

group_trips.title: Baku, Sheki and Tbilisi Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A small-group journey from Baku to Sheki, across the land border to Tbilisi, with Kazbegi's mountains and Kakheti wine country.
group_trips.overview:
This fixed-departure trip joins two Caucasus neighbours in one holiday. You begin in Baku with the Old City, the Flame Towers and the fire sites of Absheron, then head to Sheki in the Caucasus foothills for its Khan's Palace and caravanserai.

A road crossing at the border takes you into Georgia. Tbilisi is your base for four nights, with the old town, Narikala Fortress and the ancient capital of Mtskheta, a day in the mountains at Kazbegi and a day in Kakheti, Georgia's wine country.

A trip captain travels with the group, and Indian meal options are available on request. You arrive in Baku and fly home from Tbilisi.

Ateshgah Fire Temple and Yanardag burning hillside

group_trips.title: Azerbaijan Weekend Escape: Baku, Gobustan and the Fire Sites
group_trips.summary: A relaxed long weekend in Baku with the walled Old City, the Gobustan rock carvings, the fire sites of Absheron and an evening on the Caspian boulevard.
group_trips.overview:
Baku packs a surprising amount into a long weekend, and this fixed-departure escape is paced so that you see the best of it without rushing. You stay three nights in the capital, walking the UNESCO-listed Old City, strolling the Caspian-shore boulevard and seeing the Flame Towers and the Heydar Aliyev Center.

One full day goes to Gobustan, a short drive from the city, where ancient rock carvings and bubbling mud volcanoes sit in an open, stark landscape. The next day takes you to the Absheron peninsula for the Ateshgah Fire Temple and Yanardag, the hillside that burns, best seen as the light fades.

A trip captain travels with the group, and Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Baku's UNESCO-listed Old City, Icheri Sheher
Gobustan rock carvings and mud volcanoes
Ateshgah Fire Temple and Yanardag burning hillside
Flame Towers and a photo stop at the Heydar Aliyev Center
An evening walk on Baku Boulevard by the Caspian Sea
Fixed weekend departures with a trip captain

itinerary.title: Arrival in Baku | Old City and Boulevard
itinerary.description:
Arrive early at Baku airport and meet your trip captain.
Transfer to the hotel, check in as soon as the room is ready and freshen up.
In the afternoon walk through the walled Old City, Icheri Sheher, with its narrow lanes and the Maiden Tower area.
In the evening take a relaxed stroll along Baku Boulevard on the Caspian shore.
Overnight stay in Baku.

itinerary.title: Gobustan Rock Art | Heydar Aliyev Center
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive south from Baku to Gobustan.
See the ancient rock carvings in the open landscape and visit the nearby mud volcanoes.
Return to Baku and make a photo stop at the Heydar Aliyev Center.
The evening is free for dinner or a walk on Nizami Street.
Overnight stay in Baku.

itinerary.title: Absheron Fire Sites | Flame Towers
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, enjoy a slower morning at leisure.
In the afternoon drive to the Absheron peninsula to visit the Ateshgah Fire Temple.
Continue to Yanardag, the burning hillside, which looks best as the light fades.
Return to the city for a last view of the Flame Towers lit up after dark.
Overnight stay in Baku.

itinerary.title: Free Morning and Departure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, enjoy a free morning for last-minute shopping or a walk on the boulevard.
Check out from the hotel at the time confirmed by your trip captain.
Transfer to Baku airport for your late flight home.
